text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Court investigating security scandal arrests three police special force members for founding a gang and being involved in the killing of casino owner.
- Progress on regulations for the lifting of the parliamentary immunities of two government MPs involved in a security scandal.
- Head of Turkish armed forces gives Ankara's support to Turkish Cyprus in a visit amid a crisis over the planned Greek Cypriot deploment of S-300 anti-aircraft missiles.
- Ankara hosts negotiations between two rival Kurdish groups in nothern Iraq.
- A leftist opposition party lays a black wreath before the prime ministry to protest a Ramadan dinner given by Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan for the heads of religious sects.
- Former senior policeman and aide to Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller says she is involved in security scandal.
- Car manufacturer TOFAS restarts production after 18-day break.
- Court of appeal rules that wives married in religious ceremonies hold legal rights.
